summary: CODE-GATE-03: Three P2 defects. Reviewed source, tests, scripts, package/CI and affected contract docs. Two defects reproduced with write-free in-memory probes. No repository changes, paid calls, delegation, or write-producing checks.

findings.detail: Resuming an exhausted run bypasses its repair budget. Delivery persists resumeStage='repair' before the machine checks exhaustion. On /workflow resume, preflight returns passed with next='repair', which bypasses the guard that only checks repair results. Each resume therefore admits another writer without increasing or renewing the configured budget.
findings.evidence: delivery.ts:106 persists the repair stage; workflow.ts:86-93 checks exhaustion only for output.kind='repair'; workflow.ts:175 resumes through preflight. An in-memory coordinator probe with maxRepairRounds=1 executed one repair initially and a second after resume, while repairRounds remained 1.

findings.detail: An unmerged stack can fail finalization after successfully dismissing or resolving a lower-layer review thread. Monitoring checks out that layer for triage, then advances unitIndex through the remaining PRs without changing checkout. With merge disabled, retrospective audits the lower layer while requesting the final layer's head, then fails its clean-head assertion.
findings.evidence: monitor assigns unitIndex at line 657 and checks out the triaged branch at line 688; merge returns immediately without a grant at line 775. Retrospective never selects its unit before auditing and checking HEAD at line 878. A write-free probe using the actual monitor, merge and retrospective methods reproduced successful thread resolution followed by 'Committed tree changed; evidence is invalid'.

findings.detail: Stack preparation fetches from mutable origin instead of the run's recorded remote. If origin is changed after preflight to a compatible fork with additional commits, preparation merges that fork's base into the descendant and records it as the review base. Publication subsequently pushes those commits to the originally approved repository. Monitoring detects the base mismatch only after publication.
findings.evidence: Preflight binds remoteIdentity and originUrl at lines 304-315. prepare fetches origin and reads refs/remotes/origin at lines 827-830, then merges and adopts that SHA at lines 834-846. Independent review uses this adopted base at lines 564-567, while publication pushes to run.originUrl at line 604. The remote-base equality check occurs later in monitor at line 666.
